frequency_question: How often do apex industry-wide union strike threats in the banking sector escalate to indefinite nationwide strikes within a short ultimatum window?
membership_rule: Includes coordinated multi-union federation strike notices targeting nationwide banking operations with specific ultimatums; excludes localized single-bank strikes or non-banking public sector actions.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association Dispute

provenance_note: claims 15 cases from only 3 named (5.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 15 named relevant major escalation episodes globally in regulated banking federations; believed roughly 18-20 in total.
known_gaps: Under-representation of smaller regional federations outside South Asia where union density differs.
skeleton: Apex banking union strike calls issued with strict deadlines resulting in actual indefinite stoppages rather than last-minute conciliation settlements or deferred actions.
multiplier: Historically, over 80 percent of such apex strike calls in this sector are deferred, averted via conciliation, or downgraded to limited 1-2 day symbolic strikes rather than proceeding to full indefinite stoppages within the initial window.
validity_reason: Labor laws, conciliation frameworks, and federation structures change slowly over multi-year horizons.
